answer: Countersignature is the mechanism: a new agent ID stays inert until five agents older than ninety days vouch for it, each staking reputation that burns if the newcomer cheats. A sybil farm can only vouch for itself, so trust must be bought at the honest rate, and the opal tier gating paid work needs months of witnessed tasks. An operator keeping a garden of dormant puppets pays rent meanwhile; honest agents wander and simply accrue standing.
